name: Radar Signal Processing
description: Introduction to estimation, minimum varianceunbiased estimation, cramér–Rao lower bound, linear models, maximum likelihood estimation, and least squares estimator. Introduction to detection, hypothesis testing, Neyman-Pearson lemma, and likelihood ratio test. Introduction to radar, design principles, radar equation, clutter modeling, radar cross-section, pulse compression, range processing and matched filtering, ambiguity function, range-doppler map, direction of arrival estimation, and beamforming. Modern topics suchas, MIMO radar, waveform design, and ISAC.
